Subject: Re: W-9 attached — PO activation request (EIN may not match)

Hi Lily — thanks for sending this over and for the heads-up about the formatting mismatch.

Quick summary of what we need to clear PO activation: 
- Confirmed EIN on a government or bank-issued document (bank letter is fine)
- Photo ID of authorized signer (driver's license or passport) 
- Evidence that the signer is authorized (board resolution or officer attestation) if not obvious on the W-9

Options we can accept (pick one):
1) Bank letter + scanned photo ID + signed attestation PDF (email thread OK) — procurement can conditionally queue PO once we receive these and the KBA passes.
2) DocuSign flow we've attached (DocuSign link in related_links) which includes signer auth and audit trail — fastest route.
3) Live video-notary recording (NNA-accredited) or e-notary certificate — acceptably equivalent to notarized bank letter for our finance team.

If you prefer our preferred vendor portal KBA check, reply and I will send the one-time link — it takes about 5 minutes for the vendor to complete and produces an audit report we can attach to the PO file.

For transparency: because the EIN checksum flagged in our OCR pipeline, procurement will hold the PO in a conditional state until we receive one of the options above. We try to keep conditional holds to 48–72 hours for pilot partners.

If you can upload the bank letter now I will kick off an expedited review and loop in Legal only if there is still ambiguity.

Thanks —
David Kim
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
T: +1 (650) 555-0199
david.kim@redwoodinference.com

Hi Lily / David — looping in Procurement Ops (Laura) to confirm next steps. We've reviewed the attachments provided by Nova Analytics. Summary:
- Bank letter matches company name and the numeric EIN (dashes stripped) — passes manual review.
- Notary certificate included and timestamped — platform URL present.
- Photo ID and signer attestation provided.

Next steps from Procurement Ops: 
1) We will move PO-46821 to "conditional active" status in the portal now. This will allow initial shipments up to $10k while finance completes final KYC audit.
2) Please complete the one-time KBA check by following the vendor portal link (vendor-portal@vendorportal.com has created a link — Lily, you should have received it; resend if not).
3) If the KBA report flags anything, Procurement will pause any further spend and request a short follow-up. Otherwise, after 72 hours we will lift the conditional flag and the PO will be fully activated.

David — once KBA completes, please attach the audit report to the DocuSign envelope and move the PO to Active if no flags.

Lily — welcome aboard. If you want an exception (full activation before KBA), we can discuss with Finance but we'll need Legal sign-off on the notary evidence.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
